rows.grounds: compound of tanu (body) and traya (three), accusative singular neuter
compound of śrī and pādukā, accusative singular feminine
optative third singular active of root yaj

items.question: What should be worshipped after uttering the three bodies?
items.inference: After reciting the three bodies, one worships Śrīpādukā.
uncertainties: exact referent of tanutrayaṃ is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: Having uttered the three bodies, then worship Śrīpādukā.
